n: 5.8 Cu. Ft. 24 Inch Double Wall Oven with Convection
desc: Cook however you want with a 24 inch double wall oven with convection. Bake multiple items simultaneously with True Convection Cooking and clean this 24 inch self cleaning wall oven using the upper oven's Adjustable Self-Clean Cycle.
hl: When you’re busy elsewhere, use your smartphone to get dinner started by remotely preheating the oven.
Fit your own casserole dishes or bakeware in a wall oven that takes up less space and still gives you the flexibility to cook on multiple racks at once.
Cook however you want with 9 cooking modes in 1 oven: Frozen Bake™ Technology, Bake, Convect Bake, Broil, Convect Broil, Defrost, Keep Warm, Proofing and Convect Roast cycles.
Make large family meals by cooking your main course, side dishes and dessert in this 5.8 Cu. Ft. Total Capacity double wall oven.
Make room for a variety of dishes with 2 Adjustable Racks that you can move to 5 different positions inside your oven.
True Convection with Third Heating Element

True convection cooking uses the bake element, the broil element, a third heating element and a fan in the back of the oven to bake multiple items at once and circulate hot air around the oven cavity for more even heating.
